results.title: Migrants from all over the world crossed the southern border bound for Alabama
results.description: Roughly 36,000 migrants from 60 different countries who crossed the U.S. -Mexico border between 2018 and 2025 told federal agents they were coming to Alabama. Here's what we know about who they are, where they're from and where they said they were going.
